panels.visual: Socrates sitting in a small shoemaker's shop in the Agora arguing with young men, Simon the shoemaker working at his bench
panels.caption: I liked to talk with young men at Simon's shoe shop.

panels.visual: Plato and Xenophon (two young men with scrolls) writing in a notebook, Socrates in the background with empty hands
panels.caption: I never wrote a word down. My pupils Plato and Xenophon did.

panels.visual: Archaeologists brushing the dust off hobnails and bone eyelets and a clay cup base with SIMONOS scratched on it
panels.caption: They found iron hobnails and the base of a cup marked SIMONOS: 'Simon's'.

panels.visual: Socrates answering a student's question with another question, a chain of question marks, the student pulling his hair out
panels.caption: I never answered a question straight.
